title: Shared Go types across GVKs need a declared GVK, not scheme guessing
answers: Object was persisted with the wrong apiVersion for a multi-version resource
Why did a dashboard/folder get saved as v1beta1 when written through the v1 endpoint?
Datasource config persisted under the wrong API group
How to fix incorrect apiVersion/group for a type shared across versions or groups
body:
Symptom: an object constructed without TypeMeta (provisioning, migrations) or whose Go type is shared across API versions/groups gets persisted under the wrong apiVersion/group - e.g. always resolving to whichever version/group was registered first, regardless of the endpoint it arrived through.
Root cause: apistore.Storage.checkGVK (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go) used to fall back to StorageOptions.Scheme.ObjectKinds(obj), which reports every GVK a Go type is registered under; for a type shared across versions/groups that first match was registration-order-dependent, not the version actually being served.
Fix pattern: declare StorageOptions.GVK per version/group and scope it with opts.StorageOptsGetterFor(resourceInfo, storageOpts) (pkg/services/apiserver/builder/common.go) instead of the GroupResource-keyed opts.StorageOptsRegister or the bare opts.OptsGetter, both of which are shared across every version of a resource.
Constraints: applies whenever one Go type backs multiple GVKs - see pkg/registry/apis/folders/register.go:folderStorageOpts and pkg/registry/apis/datasource/register.go:UpdateAPIGroupInfo. Does not apply to resources that declare no GVK at all; those stay on the codec path (see companion note).
applies: apistore.StorageOptions consumers; any resource registry whose Go type backs more than one GVK/version/group
says: Multi-version resource object persists under wrong API version.
Dashboard saved as v1beta1 despite writing through v1 endpoint.

Why does moving resource between versions revert saved API version?
search: Shared Go types across multiple API versions/groups must declare StorageOptions.GVK explicitly per version/group, using opts.StorageOptsGetterFor(resourceInfo, storageOpts) in pkg/services/apiserver/builder/common.go, not the shared GroupResource-keyed opts.StorageOptsRegister. Without this, objects persist under wrong apiVersion/group (registration-order-dependent) when one Go type backs multiple GVKs; see pkg/registry/apis/folders/register.go:folderStorageOpts and pkg/registry/apis/datasource/register.go:UpdateAPIGroupInfo. Does not apply to resources declaring no GVK. Applies to apistore.StorageOptions consumers in resource registries with multiple GVK backing.
